data.name: Harry and the Haunted House
data.detailed_description:
Explore and share "Harry and the Haunted House", an original storybook adventure from the mind of Mark Schlichting! Through Harry and his friends, the story comes alive one word at a time, offering an easy to digest reading mode which is fully animated and voiced. Increase the challenge and the fun with an interactive at-your-own-pace option with lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

The story centers around Harry, a young and curious rabbit. During a rousing baseball game with his animal friends, Harry ends up hitting a ball right into a neighboring old mansion! The real trouble has only started, as this old mansion has a reputation for being haunted! The gang will have to investigate the haunted mansion if they want to find their ball again. Creeping around room to room, the house will come alive with apparitions both spooky and silly. Will the gang be able to maintain their courage long enough to explore all the mysteries they find inside?

Since it's first release in 1994, Living Books' rendition of "Harry and the Haunted House" has been enjoyed by countless children. Step-by-step, the reader will find the story is full of entertaining characters and surprising scenes. All while providing new ways to interact with the book again and again.

  • Both interactive and story modes suitable for different levels of skill.

  • Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes.

  • Attractive animations bring the characters to life.

  • Fully voiced as you read! Chock full of many memorable scenes!

  • A revitalized re-release compatible with modern platforms.
